target.intervening_scope: Estate Evolution status/receipt files only; the Turn-3 S1-S6 implementation/control files were unchanged.

accepted_findings: The proof-weighted audit supplied mutable main/master refs to repository checkout.
The audit standard required exact branch and commit identity for a works claim.
The featured verifier preserved the supplied ref but did not independently record the checked-out commit SHA.
The Helix ownership manifest contained an older verified_commit checkpoint.
The smallest reusable repair was to bind execution receipts to checked-out commit identity and fail closed when identity cannot be resolved.

semantic_quarantine.adversarial_breaker: Unsupported deployment/security specifics, CVE/CVSS thresholds, signatures, expiry, percentages and fraud rhetoric were not promoted.
semantic_quarantine.bottleneck_cartographer: Cryptographic/asynchronous inevitability and unexecuted disconfirming-test claims were not promoted.
semantic_quarantine.innovation_inventor: BLAKE3, timing, scale and latency mechanics remain experiment proposals rather than observations.
semantic_quarantine.leverage_analyst: Unsupported LOC, no-blocker, all-VCS and full-compliance claims were not promoted.
semantic_quarantine.presentation_strategist: Invented AST, cyclomatic, method-call, timestamp and employer-role details were not promoted.
semantic_quarantine.proof_engineer: Unproven pytest.ini/conftest and missing-execution assertions were not promoted.
semantic_quarantine.source_mapper: Source-file presence was not treated as operational status or a closed verification loop.

baseline_repair.purpose: Repair pre-existing Ruff debt and a stale 49-vs-48 root-truth test assertion separately from the proof-identity change.

stale_proof_branch.preservation: Useful proof-identity delta was replayed onto fresh canonical ancestry rather than merging the stale tip.

promoted_behavior: Resolve exact checked-out content identity with git rev-parse --verify HEAD^{commit} and a strict 40-hex SHA.
Preserve the supplied ref separately from resolved_commit_sha and identity_status.
Fail closed as BLOCKED_IDENTITY when exact content identity cannot be established.
Pre-collect pytest nodes so positive test proof does not depend on human-facing quiet-summary prose.
Run exact-PR-head self-verification and require the emitted receipt to match the executed commit.

independent_artifact_readback.meaning: Immutable identity was captured without inflating a failing workload into VERIFIED proof.

truth_boundary: This receipt proves seven role-bound SparkForge lane receipts, three closed adaptive tuning events, semantic adjudication, fresh-head synthesis, exact-head verification and canonical promotion of the surviving proof-identity repair. It does not promote quarantined worker prose, does not claim every audited repository passes its workload, and does not automatically promote the Helix ownership manifest verified_commit merely because the repair merged.
next_cursor: Evaluate verified_commit advancement only from post-merge canonical execution evidence; continue Make-It-Heavy with content-addressed proof plus semantic entailment, not source-ID presence alone.
